nodes.label: AI Export Technical Series and Density Contract
nodes.description: Resolved decision (updated 2026-08-03): technical series kept homogeneous native-market prices, deduplicated per unique asset_id, scope-complete. Density reduced via deterministic sampling. Signal Density V2 and 2026-08-03 amendment fix history/event density without scope changes, size-triggered truncation, or silent downgrade. Standard event selection: complete 21-day window + minimum latest 10 per entity/annotation. Indicator history: Compact 5 / Standard 10 / Full all non-empty rows. Final evidence authorities: targeted run 20260801T085820.657238Z (4/4 prompts) and applied-policy run 20260803T164514.504966Z (7/7 prompts). Dense Portfolio/Broker may exceed 60k tokens; UI warning remains; no automatic cap.

nodes.label: Signal Density V2
nodes.description: Beta-v1 in-place density contract: component/dataset/analysis/sampling/manifest/response IDs remain v1; each signal plugin resolves one SignalTemporalClass; central detail_level x temporal_class matrix owns P/M/K; 18/18 combinations valid, 54/54 theory/runtime bucket counts match for 90/180/365d; no legacy fallback or silent downgrade. Event selection by detail level: Compact 7d/min3, Standard 21d/min10, Full 30d/min20 per entity/annotation.

nodes.label: Detail Level x Temporal Class Sampling Matrix
nodes.description: Central matrix pairing detail_level (Compact/Standard/Full) with plugin-resolved SignalTemporalClass to determine P/M/K bucket counts; all 18 official combinations valid, 54/54 theory/runtime counts match for 90, 180, and 365 days; price/rate sampling unchanged.

nodes.label: Technical vs Financial Series Separation
nodes.description: Homogeneous native-market price series for technical analysis; target-currency financial valuation kept separate; mixed-currency series explicitly error-tagged and sends empty series to signal calculation so indicators become unavailable rather than mathematically invalid.

nodes.label: Inter-Bucket Price/FX Return Anchors
nodes.description: Price/FX returns anchor on previous non-empty bucket close; first populated bucket is null when no deterministic pre-period observation was loaded; Portfolio/Broker period return derives from TWRR; FX carry-forward observations excluded from returns and volatility.

nodes.label: 2026-08-03 Indicator Density Amendment
nodes.description: Deterministic uniform sample of non-empty indicator buckets per entity/instance: Compact 5, Standard 10, Full all non-empty rows; first/last rows always represented; latest values and period_summary use the complete exported period; technical_sampling.indicator_history_row_limit makes the policy public; empty rows omitted but counts remain auditable; no observed zero converted to absence. Event density: Compact 7-day window/min latest 3; Standard 21-day window/min latest 10; Full 30-day window/min latest 20. Applied-policy run 20260803T164514.504966Z: 7/7 prompts, zero failures. Dense Portfolio/Broker may exceed 60k; no automatic cap.

nodes.label: Standard Event Selection Policy: Complete 21-Day Recent Window + Minimum Latest 10 per Entity/Annotation (Approved 2026-08-03)
nodes.description: Explicit owner-approved event selection contract: for each entity_id + annotation_key, Compact exports complete latest 7 calendar days + at least latest 3 events; Standard exports complete latest 21 calendar days + at least latest 10; Full exports complete latest 30 calendar days + at least latest 20. No ranking, relevance score, family quota, or hard cap inside the complete recent window. Project owner explicitly approved the Standard 21-day/minimum-10 policy on 3 August 2026. Each group reports full detected/recent/exported counts and detected/exported date ranges.

nodes.label: Final Targeted Evidence Run 20260801T085820.657238Z: 4/4 Prompts, Zero Failures/Skips/Regressions
nodes.description: Run ID: 20260801T085820.657238Z. Designated by the project owner on 3 August 2026 as the final targeted focused evidence run for empty temporal-row hardening and explicit Broker nomenclature. Covered 4/4 targeted prompts with no failures, skips, or regressions; UI/probe equivalence 4/4; secret scan passed; source and production databases unchanged.

nodes.label: Applied-Policy Validation Run 20260803T164514.504966Z: 7/7 Prompts, Zero Failures, Zero Public-Output Violations
nodes.description: Run ID: 20260803T164514.504966Z. Final applied-policy authority for Standard 21-day/min-10 event selection and Compact 5/Standard 10/Full all indicator history density. Completed 7/7 prompts with zero failures and zero public-output violations; UI/probe equivalence 7/7; secret scan passed; source and production databases unchanged. Dense Portfolio and Broker cases can exceed 60k estimated tokens; the UI warning remains and no automatic cap is applied.

nodes.label: Empty Temporal-Row Public Rendering Hardening: Omit Only Completely Empty Rows
nodes.description: Public renderer omits a temporal row only when it is completely empty: no observation, economic value, flow, P&L, extrema, reconciliation, economic date, or explicit state. Observed zero remains data. Diagnostics report detected/omitted/rendered row counts. Backend buckets, calculations, frequency, and sampling are unchanged. Approved by project owner on 3 August 2026; validated by targeted run 20260801T085820.657238Z.

nodes.label: Indicator History Density Policy: Compact 5 / Standard 10 / Full All Non-Empty Rows
nodes.description: Deterministic uniform sample of non-empty indicator buckets: Compact detail level exports 5 rows; Standard exports 10 rows; Full exports all non-empty rows. First and last rows always represented. Latest values and period_summary use the complete exported period. technical_sampling.indicator_history_row_limit publishes the policy. Empty rows omitted from payload; source bucket and source non-empty row counts retained for auditability.

nodes.label: Signals Domain
nodes.description: Domain covering technical analysis indicators, signal plugins, temporal classes, and the AI Export signal-density policies linked by this decision.

hyperedges.label: 3 August 2026 Triple Owner Approval: empty-row hardening + Broker nomenclature + targeted run 20260801T085820.657238Z
hyperedges.description: On 3 August 2026 the project owner simultaneously approved: (1) final public empty-temporal-row hardening, (2) explicit Broker universe nomenclature, (3) designated targeted run 20260801T085820.657238Z as the final focused evidence. All three stated in the same approval paragraph.

hyperedges.label: Applied-Policy Density Package: amendment + event-policy 21d/min10 + indicator-history 5/10/all + run 20260803T164514
hyperedges.description: The 2026-08-03 density amendment, Standard 21-day/min-10 event selection policy, Compact5/Standard10/Full-all indicator history policy, and applied-policy validation run 20260803T164514.504966Z form one cohesive approved and validated package described in the same section.

hyperedges.label: Signal Density V2 Complete Sampling Spec: temporal-class matrix + event-policy 21d/min10 + indicator-history 5/10/all
hyperedges.description: Signal Density V2 is fully specified by: the detail_level x temporal_class matrix for indicator bucket counts, the Standard 21-day/min-10 event selection policy, and the Compact 5/Standard 10/Full all indicator history row limit. Together they define the complete deterministic sampling contract.
